entries.8e76bb8434d505bf: Toward 2030, it has defined the society DIC contributes to as 'Green,' 'Digital' and 'Quality of Life (QOL),' and its policy is to concentrate management resources in business areas where it can leverage its strengths. The basic strategies of its long-term management plan 'DIC Vision 2030' are transformation of its business portfolio and sustainability strategy. For the transformation of the business portfolio, it aims to raise the earnings power of its core businesses through structural reform of inks, packaging materials, pigments and polymers, and through product portfolio shifts, and it positions Chemitronics and Composites/Devices as growth businesses supporting an 'AI-integrated society' in which AI is integrated into social systems, providing materials and solutions mainly in the fields of semiconductors, batteries and physical AI. The sustainability strategy consists of developing sustainable products, reducing CO2 emissions and responding to the circular economy. From fiscal 2026 to fiscal 2030, as the final phase (Phase2), it intends to focus resources on growth businesses while enhancing the earnings power of its core businesses.

entries.a84d3eb83e7cf12b: A business that manufactures and sells pigments for paints, plastics, inks, specialty uses, color filters and cosmetics, as well as health food products. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥215,192 million (¥218,075 million in the previous year). Pigments for paints and pigments for plastics, which account for a large share of revenue, saw shipments fall as demand stalled, centered on Europe and the United States, amid uncertainty over the economic outlook; however, revenue rose through efforts to revise prices. Pigments for color filters saw shipments fall below the prior year as panel manufacturers' operating rates remained unstable, but revenue rose due to the effect of product mix. Pigments for cosmetics saw revenue decline due to stagnant demand from cosmetics manufacturers in Europe and the United States. Pigments for specialty uses saw revenue rise as shipments for agricultural applications recovered and construction applications also grew. Outside pigments, revenue from liquid crystal material products declined because the company withdrew from the liquid crystal materials business.
